The Legacy of Osman the Mediocre
For all the pomp and propaganda about the splendor of his reign, not much can actually be said about the late Osman II. He was a mediocre ruler that achieved more in death than he ever did in life.
The Legacy of Osman the Capable
While he achieved no grand conquests or major administrative reforms, Osman II did achieve some reforms in the military.
The Legacy of Osman the Tactician

During his life, the late Osman II achieved several major reforms within our military. He built a modern, capable army that enables our continued existance and strikes fear in the hearts of our enemies.
The Legacy of Osman the Dreamer
While he achieved no grand conquests or reforms within the army, Osman II enacted several administrative reforms to build a more advanced and meritocratic state. A champion of the commoners.
The Legacy of Osman the Analyst

While he never achieved grand conquests, Osman II did attempt to modernize our society and army, with some success. While his reforms never achieved their full potential, had he lived longer there is no doubt we would have been better off.
The Legacy of Osman the Strategist

Osman II lived a long and good life. He achieved major reforms within our military, enabling us to strike deep into the lands of our enemies. He also achieved some administrative reforms, laying the groundwork for a more just society.
The Legacy of Osman the Reformer

Osman II achieved several key reforms to our administrative system during his life. He created a more meritocratic society, he funded the arts, he supported the then quite new concept of industry which has now become the backbone of our economy. He was a studious man, a good man.
The Legacy of Osman the Planner
Osman II achieved several key administrative reforms during his reign that turned us to a modern state. He was also able to ensure the start of the modernizing process for our army.
The Legacy of Osman the Tenacious

Osman II was able to achieve major reforms both to our state and to our army. He built a truly meritocratic society, and was able to create a modern army, capable of defeating anyone that would oppose us. We are sad to see him go.
The Legacy of Osman the General

While Osman II was not able to achieve any reforms to our state or the army, he was still able to achieve key victories against our enemies. While not on the same level as his father or his grandfather, he was a decent ruler.
The Legacy of Osman the Historian

Osman II was known for his love for history, and his diligent study of it. The knowledge he attained from those dusty old tomes were pivotal to the ideas he implemented within our army, and to the tactics he employed against our enemies.
The Legacy of Osman the Marshal
Osman II was a true visionary when it came to military matters. He achieved a truly modern army and was able to utilize it well against our enemies. A sultan that will not soon be forgotten.
The Legacy of Osman the Progressive

Osman II was a true progressive, a champion of the common man. He achieved glory for the nation with his wars and major reforms to the state, leading to a stronger, more just state. A man that will not soon be forgotten.
The Legacy of Osman the Generalist

Osman II was able to achieve small steps in several areas. He gained glory and renown with his wars, he achieved some great reforms to the state and he started building a grand army. Alas, he was but one man and could not achieve any of his grand goals, but what he did achieve was still commendable.
The Legacy of Osman the Organizer

The legacy of Osman II includes many achievments, but they are bound to be overshadowed by his military reforms. His reforms and new concepts that he implemented in the army built the backbone of our nation, and will serve as the shield protecting us in the decades to come.
The Legacy of Osman the Modernizer
Osman II was a true modernizer. He achieved key reforms to our state that has made us true equals of many of the states of Europe. A lightbringer, a radical, a sultan.
The Legacy of Osman the Conscientious

Osman II was a true monarch. He achieved conquests for our nation, overhauled our adminstration and implemented key reforms to our military. While some may say his reforms left something to be desired, no one can deny his ambition.
The Legacy of Osman the Ambitious

Osman II was a good sultan. He achieved all of the reforms he promised and more, and he gave us our nation as it stands today. A man of high moral fiber, and a truly splendid mind. We can only dream that we get such a man in leadership again.
The Legacy of Osman the Conqueror

Osman II was a truly great Sultan, achieving key victories against all of our enemies and cementing us as the dominant power in the Middle East. Our enemies will tell tales of his wars for years to come, whispering his name in fear. His father cast a long shadow, and Osman II was able to achieve greatness anyways. An inspiration for our people.
The Legacy of Osman the Campaigner

Osman II was able to achieve multiple awe inspiring feats against our enemies, and much of it was thanks to the reforms he implemented in the army. A man that showed both tactical brilliance and a shrewd logistical mind, a blessing for our entire nation.
The Legacy of Osman the Mastermind

Osman II had a truly great reign. He overhauled our armed forces, giving us the fiercest army in the world, and was able to utilize it against our enemies with pinpoint precision to become their worst nightmare. People debate who the best general of all time is to this day, was it Caesar, Hannibal, or Napoleon? The answer is that it is Osman, a general without an equal.
The Legacy of Osman the Champion

Osman II had a truly great reign. He won the hearts of our entire nation with his victorious conquests, and ever the philosopher he achieved several key reforms to our state to make it a more just and noble society. We can only hope that future generations look to him as a shining example of a ruler.
The Legacy of Osman the Architect

Osman II had an iron will and proved it to his people. His fierce soul allowed him to triumph against our enemies, his fierce sense of justice led him to reform our state to help the common man, and his fierce ingenuity resulted in our army modernizing and becoming a capable force with few equals. A beacon of hope in a dark world, Osman II will be mourned for centuries to come.
The Legacy of Osman the Innovator

Osman II had a truly splendid reign. He put our enemies to death, he implemented several reforms to our administrative system, and most importantly he used his love for history and the military to overhaul our army to become the strongest, most dangerous force in the entire world. His ingenuity knew no bounds, and we are unlikely to ever see such a great man ever again.
The Legacy of Osman the Enlightened

Osman II had a truly marvelous reign. He won the hearts of the entire nation with his victorious conquests, and then he earned their undying loyalty with his reforms to the state. A champion of the people, a hero, a father of the nation.
The Legacy of Osman the Visionary

Osman II was a man with grandiose dreams and ambitions, a man with a vision for a new Rum. Many people simply dream, but Osman II was not just a dreamer, but a builder. He used his power and sharp mind to outwit our enemies on the field of battle, building an empire without equal. He used his influence and his strong sense of ethics to build the people of Rum a new, fair and just nation. He used his understanding of warfare to reform our small but powerful army into a force to be reckoned with, a force with no equal. One of the greatest monarchs to ever grace the Orient.
The Legacy of Osman the Great

When his father died, many questioned what would become of the young sultan Osman II. His father had achieved our independence, and built a strong and stable nation. His grandfather oversaw the overhaul to our armed forces that achieved key victories against our enemies. Tough legacies to beat. Yet despite this, Osman II was able to surpass them both. He crushed our enemies on the field of battle, the terror of Cappadocia. He overhauled our administrative systems, creating a rich, beautiful and just society. He reformed our army, creating the strongest force the Orient has ever seen. A man with no equal, a man who through his reign shall live eternally, the greatest monarch the world has ever seen.
